entities.summary: The Kolochin culture, also called Kalochyn culture, was an Iron Age culture which flourished on the territory of present-day Ukraine, southeastern Belarus and southwestern Russia, from the 4th or 5th to the 7th century. It was the northeastern element of the Prague-Penkivka-Kolochin cultural complex.
